name: Ryan Sellers
tagline: Top rated Estate & Trust Litigation attorney in Dallas, Texas
side_practice_areas: Estate & Trust Litigation, Civil Litigation, Personal Injury
about: A partner at Hales & Sellers, PLLC, in Dallas, Texas, Ryan Sellers provides judicious legal representation to clients throughout the surrounding region, aiming to give them the peace of mind that their assets are secured for their loved ones. He handles all aspects of estate planning and administration matters, ranging from wills and trusts to probate law, and fights tooth and nail to ensure his clients’ legacies are well-protected into the distant future and beyond.

Mr. Sellers completed his undergraduate studies in 2010, graduating with his Bachelor of Arts degree in political science and government from The University of Tennessee in Knoxville. He went on to attend the Baylor University Law School, where he honed his shrewd legal acumen and talents, which have made an impact in every case he has taken on since entering the legal profession. He received his Juris Doctor in 2014, and in the very next year, he obtained his license to practice law across all Texas state courts.

With a clear drive to accumulate as much practical and legal knowledge as possible to help his clients, Mr. Sellers earned his Master of Laws degree in litigation from his law school alma mater in 2024. His enthusiasm to help his clients overcome their complex legal challenges has not gone unnoticed within his legal community, with many of his peers applauding him for his client-centric advocacy and dedication to achieving their goals amicably, and with grace and poise.
